_comment: Default risky-action list for the approval-cards module. A rule is {id, match: shell|url (or a list of them), pattern (JavaScript regex source), flags (default i), summary, outside_workdir?}. match shell tests the Bash/PowerShell command; url tests the url of a fetch tool. outside_workdir: the rule only counts when a path argument of the matched command points outside the task folder. Extend or switch off rules in the config under approval_cards (risky, skip); see the module README.

rules.summary: pushes commits to a remote repository
deletes files outside the task folder
calls a paid API, which may spend money
